build_source_binding_basis: caller-supplied commit and observed binary hash; not independent attestation

configuration_adaptation.bounds: candidate timeouts 0..60 seconds, secret 1..256 bytes, PAP username 1..253 and password 1..128 bytes, NAS-Identifier <=253 bytes
configuration_adaptation.candidate: same native host/port/secret API; UDP address must be process-enrolled, with no process secret or ambient DNS
configuration_adaptation.excluded: arbitrary DNS/destinations, CIDR/strict-IP/batch token parameters, non-PAP authentication, independent production RADIUS server qualification
configuration_adaptation.numeric: common stored i64 NAS-Port behavior tested; invalid port transport failures and numeric overflow are not full API parity claims
configuration_adaptation.oracle: native API host/port/secret without process address enrollment
configuration_adaptation.request_message_authenticator: candidate mandatory; official 2.6.2 PAP omits it
configuration_adaptation.response: both receive signed Response-Authenticator and Message-Authenticator
